column4: note

package-private bounded primitive byte sink shared by the raw encoders: reset(maximum, hint) keeps at most 64 KiB of scratch, append / appendLE16 / append(range) refuse past the output cap, finish() copies the exact bytes (output never aliases scratch)

opt-in LZ4 raw block encoder (no frame): token nibbles + 255-run extensions, little-endian 16-bit offsets up to 65,535, last match starting at least 12 bytes before the end and the last 5 bytes literal (LZ4 block format end-of-block rules); one reusable sink and candidate index per instance, one worker per instance

opt-in Snappy raw (unframed) encoder: uncompressed-length varint, literal tags (1..4 extra length bytes above 60), COPY_2 tags (length 1..64, little-endian 16-bit offset), matches split into 64-byte copies; no frame, chunk or CRC

closure of both encoders: single-probe four-byte-prefix candidate table (positions, keys, epochs; 2^8..2^20 slots), epoch isolation instead of a clear, exact key re-check before a candidate is returned
closure of both encoders: format-neutral LZ byte kernels commonPrefix (Arrays.mismatch), commonPrefixes (batch lanes), copyMatch (overlapping back-reference expansion)

donor wire oracle: 1,600 seeded inputs + one 250,000-byte block through both encoders, exact SHA-256 of the wire bytes (Snappy c2740cd2..., LZ4 96998fbf...), exact-cap and cap-1 refusals, input immutability, sink reset / trim / aliasing checks; optional M3WR corpus file argument
donor JUnit wrapper (runAll); plain JUnit 5, no native bridge needed, so relocated as is
optional diagnostic main (ThreadMXBean allocated bytes per call, 10,000 warm-up + 30,000 measured calls per codec and input shape); not run by surefire; figures recorded in GATES.tsv
closure oracle of the candidate index and the prefix kernel (pure Java, M3LzByteKernels + M3LzMatchCandidateIndex only)
donor JUnit wrapper of the candidate-index oracle

census leaf P2-125 (crate m3-compression-chunk-cache-20261030): opt-in format-neutral cache of deterministic compressed chunks; 2^1..2^12 direct-mapped array slots (raw, encoded, SHA-256, wire profile, recency stamp), payload budget on raw + encoded bytes with least-recently-used eviction, a hit needs the profile, the SHA-256 and exact raw equality, the encoder runs outside the monitor on a private input copy and a mutating encoder is refused, returned arrays never alias retained ones, trim() bumps a generation that revokes in-flight fills; independent of the encoders

donor JDK-only oracle (Deflater / Inflater raw level 1): exact encoded bytes, hit / miss accounting, aliasing, window offsets, argument refusals, oversize bypass, mutating-encoder refusal, 500 seeded collisions in a 2-slot 1,300-byte cache, trim, six-thread replay, reentrant and cross-thread in-flight trims
donor JUnit wrapper (runAll)

decoder leaf: bounds-checked decoder of one LZ4 raw block (no frame); the decoded size is out-of-band (expectedBytes) under an allocation cap; refuses truncation, offset 0 or beyond the output, sequences past the declared output, a stream ending after a match and trailing bytes; the canonical one-byte zero token for empty output; matches expanded by M3LzByteKernels.copyMatch (overlap-safe); like the reference decoder it does not enforce the encoder-side end-of-block rules (GATES.tsv decoders_agreement)

decoder leaf: bounded decoder of one Snappy raw (unframed) block: uncompressed-length varint (at most 5 bytes) checked against the output cap before allocation, literal tags (60..63 = 1..4 length bytes), COPY_1 / COPY_2 / COPY_4 tags, offset 0 or beyond the output and lengths past the declared size refused, exact size required

four-way leaf: opt-in four-way bucketed variant of M3LzMatchCandidateIndex (same three primitive lanes and slot budget, 4 distinct exact four-byte keys per bucket, refresh in place on a hit, vacant-epoch or oldest-position eviction); package-private; no encoder uses it (GATES.tsv fourway_encoding records ratio and speed of an encoder twin that does)

decoder leaf oracle: 2,200 seeded inputs (24 size edges x 8 shapes, then random sizes) through both encoders and back through both donor decoders, exact-cap determinism, cap-1 refusals, argument refusals
donor JUnit wrapper of the row above

decoder leaf oracle: 100,000 random byte streams through both decoders under a 1,024-byte cap (only IllegalArgumentException), 5,000 bit-flipped encoder blocks (deterministic accept / refuse), four independent workers x 1,000 round trips
donor JUnit wrapper of the row above

decoder leaf oracle: hand-built token grammar (1,600 LZ4 blocks with long extensions and overlapping matches, 1,500 Snappy streams with all three copy tags, 70,000-byte extended literals) and 14 malformed streams
donor JUnit wrapper of the row above

decoder leaf interop main (not run by surefire): replays an M3CZ corpus written by independently built native codecs (liblz4, libsnappy) through both decoders; corpus argument required; run in the scratch interop lane (GATES.tsv decoders_native_interop)
decoder leaf interop main (not run by surefire): writes the M3EC corpus (250 inputs x both encoders) for decoding by independent native codecs; run in the scratch interop lane

four-way leaf oracle: argument / state refusals, mutable-input invalidation, epoch wrap (reflection on the epoch field), 320 seeded blocks of stable replay with byte-exact bounded candidates, and the four-key collision witness (direct-mapped 0 hits, four-way 156)
donor JUnit wrapper of the row above

native leaf: explicitly loaded JNI batch prefix matcher (2 native methods: nativeAbi, nativeMatches); load(Path) takes an absolute real path, checks ABI 1 and proves parity against the Java kernel before it is usable; batches bounded to 16 MiB input and 65,536 lanes; every native result re-checked against its maximum; never selected implicitly: M3LzByteKernels stays the default (Java) backend

native leaf oracle: 2,000 seeded Java prefix / overlap-copy / Snappy literal cases, Snappy tag probes and refusals, and, when m3.lz.library names a built library, a 4,096-lane JNI parity batch and the empty batch
donor JUnit wrapper of the row above (the JNI lane runs only with m3.lz.library)
native leaf oracle main (library path argument; not run by surefire): small and full batches, a deterministic corpus and concurrent replays against the Java kernel (single call-scoped native arena)
native leaf oracle: 128 seeded blocks, direct-mapped and four-way candidate lanes through the Java kernel and, with m3.lz.library, the JNI kernel
donor JUnit wrapper of the row above

native leaf: pure C11 prefix kernel m3_lz_prefix (8-byte memcpy word compare, scalar tail) and the two JNI entry points; one aligned call-scoped arena per batch filled by Get*ArrayRegion, every lane range checked, no Java array pointer retained; standalone build (M3_LZ_STANDALONE) without jni.h for the C oracle
native leaf C oracle: 1,024 seeded lanes against a scalar reference, an all-equal run and a single mismatch

native leaf build file: shared library m3_lz_compression (C11, -Wall -Wextra -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wshadow -Wpedantic -Werror; /W4 /WX on MSVC) and the CTest oracle m3_lz_test; relocated as the module's native build (no registration into another module)
